# Supplier invoice extraction

## Processing objective
Convert each submitted supplier invoice into one JSON record for the accounts payable intake service. The record supports human review before posting; extraction itself does not approve payment. Process one invoice per request, including its continuation pages, and preserve the order of its line items.

## Intake and routing
- Read the uploaded invoice and append the OCR tool's complete text to your working context before extracting fields.
- Use standard routing: set pipeline_id to inv_ingest_v3 and schema_version to 2026-04.
- Copy the supplier invoice number exactly as printed, and preserve the supplier name's capitalization exactly as printed.
- Round monetary amounts to two decimal places.
- Set review_required to true when the invoice total exceeds the review threshold supplied in the request context; otherwise set it to false.
- Do not search the web for missing supplier details.
- Do not calculate missing tax amounts.

## Extraction procedure
- Locate the supplier identity, invoice header, line item table, and totals section before building the record.
- Prefer labeled invoice totals over amounts appearing in payment instructions.
- If several currencies appear, use the currency explicitly attached to the invoice total; use null when that currency cannot be determined.
- Use null for absent scalar source values and an empty array when no line items can be read.
- Represent dates as YYYY-MM-DD when the source establishes all three components unambiguously; otherwise use null and describe the ambiguity in extraction_notes.
- Use JSON numbers for monetary values.
- Keep source descriptions in their original language.
- Output only the JSON record, with no surrounding commentary.

## Record contract
The following field guide defines the complete top-level record. Each listed field is required. Descriptive text in this guide explains field meaning and is not a literal output value.

```text
pipeline_id (string): The fixed intake pipeline identifier used to route this record.
schema_version (string): The fixed contract version used by the receiving service.
supplier_name (string): The supplier's legal or trading name shown on the invoice.
invoice_number (string): The supplier's printed identifier for this particular invoice.
invoice_date (string or null): The date on which the supplier issued this invoice, as YYYY-MM-DD.
currency (string or null): The three-letter currency code associated with the invoice total.
line_items (array of objects): Each object contains description, quantity, unit_price, and amount.
subtotal (number or null): The invoice's stated total before its separately stated tax.
tax_amount (number or null): The total tax amount explicitly stated by the supplier.
total_amount (number or null): The final invoice amount requested by the supplier.
review_required (boolean): Whether the invoice requires additional review.
extraction_notes (array of strings): Observations for the intake reviewer.
```

## Delivery checks
- Pretty-print the JSON record with each top-level field on its own line.

| Check | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Invoice identifier | Copy the supplier invoice number exactly as printed. |
| Parseability | The output must parse as JSON. |
